semiconductor_relevance: High — Nissei Electric manufactures specialized components used in semiconductor manufacturing equipment and related applications.
summary: Nissei Electric is a manufacturer of high-performance electrical and electronic components, focusing on products such as optical fiber products, fluororesin tubes, and interface cables specifically designed for semiconductor manufacturing environments. Their offerings are tailored to enhance performance and reliability in various applications, including semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
capabilities: Optical fiber products for semiconductor manufacturing
Partially fused flat cables for harsh environments
High-flex robot cables and communication cables

regional_presence.Japan: Headquartered in Hamamatsu City, Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan.
